      description: The Engineer might fail to signal completion, causing the Team Leader to wait indefinitely or re-assign the task.
      severity: 0.4

      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Team Leader cannot mark the overall task as complete, leaving the system in a pending state.

      description: If the Engineer incorrectly marks the task as finished despite the code being incomplete or buggy.
      severity: 0.7
